name: Jorgan Hage
description: Second in command of the kentsu, possessed by Overdark's assassin powers and made general.

description_citations.text: "Ramses Overdark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jorgan Hage ambushes Overdark for revenge, but Overdark subdues him and infuses him with black mana, making him a minion.
timeline.quote: Overdark easily subdues him, however, and infuses Hage with black mana, making him the assassin's minion without his knowledge.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor, furious at Overdark's failure, gives the task of culling the rebellion to Elsdragon and Hage.
timeline.quote: The emperor is furious about the assassin's failure.

citation.text: "Assassin's Blade", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Argenti Hage learns Ayesha became the forest's avatar and killed all Kentsu there; Overdark rescues Hage.
timeline.quote: Just before he is about to die, Hage is saved by Overdark

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Wasitora routs the legion sent to level Umezawa Manor.
timeline.quote: that group is intercepted and routed by Wasitora

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tetsuo levels the Kentsu at the shrine with a meteor storm and kills Hage.
timeline.quote: Only the black-mana-infused Jorgan Hage survives but is killed by Tetsuo's sword.

citation.text: "Champion's Trial", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Kentsu strike Kusho; Ayesha is captured by Gosta's defenders and escapes with Ramirez's help.
timeline.quote: Ayesha is captured by the island's defenders

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meha creates a chasm to block Kushoan reinforcements, and Hage, who wanted to slaughter them, nearly kills Meha as punishment.
timeline.quote: Meha creates a chasm to prevent Kushoan reinforcements from reaching the battle.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, who decapitates Elsdragon and seizes the title of highest general of the Kentsu.
timeline.quote: Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, and orders the Ærathi to decapitate Elsdragon and seize the title of highest general of the Kentsu.

citation.text: "Emperor's Fist", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Emperor orders Elsdragon to invade the Edemis; Hage assassinates Elsdragon and seizes command.
timeline.quote: Hage, now under Overdark’s control, took advantage of the chaos to assassinate Elsdragon

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Umezawa kills Xira Arien and Jorgan Hage, storms the Imperial Shrine and decapitates Overdark, absorbing his power.
timeline.quote: Umezawa decapitated the assassin and absorbed his magical power

citation.text: "Madara-Edemi War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ramses lures Jorgan Hage into a trap and corrupts him with black magic.
timeline.quote: Ramses then lured Hage into a trap, ambushing him and corrupting him with black magic

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orca turns on Umezawa; in the distraction Hage smashes Elsdragon's head with his hammer.
timeline.quote: Jorgan Hage seized the opportunity of distraction and smashed Elsdragon's head with his hammer.

citation.text: "Marhault Elsdragon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Overdark disobeys Bolas's orders, sending agents to the islands, including Halfdane and a forged decree to bring Orca.
timeline.quote: But Overdark disobeyed the direct orders of the emperor and sent agents to the islands anyway.

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Sidelined". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orca turns on the kentsu and Hage decapitates Elsdragon, usurping the title of general as Overdark's minion.
timeline.quote: Hage decapitated Elsdragon and usurped the title of general

citation.text: "Ramses Overdark", section "Sidelined". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
